TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi abstract sealed beforefieldinit ConnectorServiceCollectionExtensions extends System.Object

Docs.summary: Extension methods for registering connector clients in . Each method binds connection settings from an section and registers the client as a singleton.

remarks.para: The configuration section must contain a ConnectionRuntimeUrl key. An optional ManagedIdentityClientId key selects the managed identity:

item.description: Not set (null) — resolves from DI, or defaults to system-assigned managed identity.
Non-empty string — user-assigned managed identity with that client ID.
